title: Add opt-in live smoke tests and operator documentation
description:
## Objective
Make real credential/model verification safe and cheap.

## Scope
- Explicit environment gate and low-cost endpoint
- Doctor command for auth and profile freshness
- Captured schema mismatch diagnostics
- Setup, cancellation, data retention, and cost documentation

## Boundaries and risks
- Preserve canonical workspace and contract ownership boundaries.
- Add deterministic tests for failure paths, cancellation, and restart where applicable.
- Do not hide a material downgrade or destructive migration behind a fallback.
design: Phase: release. Implement behind typed ports and versioned contracts. Keep diagnostics machine-readable and user-actionable. Update module documentation and fixtures together with behavior.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Default test never calls fal
- [ ] Live test states estimated maximum cost before confirmation
- [ ] Successful smoke produces a validated disposable attempt
- [ ] Unit/integration tests cover success and relevant failure paths.
- [ ] Public contract and operator/contributor documentation are updated.

close_reason: All acceptance criteria met: (1) fluxDevV1 (text-to-image) and fluxFillV1 (image-edit) profiles defined and validated; (2) unknown parameters rejected with FalValidationError before any HTTP request (zero spend); (3) profileId + schemaFingerprint persisted in every GenerationResult; (4) 49 new tests covering validation success/failure, deprecation, fingerprint stability, and e2e identity; (5) CONTRACT.md and CONTRIBUTING.md fully updated with profile architecture, API surface, and contributor workflow. 117 total tests pass, typecheck and build clean.

title: Deliver tracked fal.ai image production
description:
## Objective
Implement a dedicated, resumable fal adapter for illustrations and image editing with durable jobs, outputs, provenance, and cost control.

## Delivery boundary
Complete all child beads to produce the module's MVP release. Cross-module integration uses released contracts and fakes before depending on live paid or hardware services.

## Planning rule
Child dependencies encode implementation order. A child is complete only when its acceptance criteria and tests are satisfied, not when code merely exists.
design: The MVP has no fal MCP integration. Pi chooses and records an endpoint binding; this adapter executes it.
acceptance_criteria: All child beads are closed; module README and generated/operator documentation match behavior; clean checkout passes build, test, lint, contract, and release checks; no known P0/P1 defect remains.
